local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local AudioConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioConfig"))
local Events = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events")
local OnPlaySound = Events:WaitForChild("Effect"):WaitForChild("OnPlaySound")

local AudioHelper = {}
local isClient = RunService:IsClient()
local rng = Random.new()

local currentBGM
local musicTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)

local function copyOptions(options)
    local result = {}
    for key, value in pairs(options or {}) do
        result[key] = value
    end
    return result
end

local function getEffectFolder()
    return SoundService:FindFirstChild("EffectSound")
end

local function validateRegistry()
    local folder = getEffectFolder()
    if not folder then
        warn("[AudioConfig] SoundService.EffectSound is missing")
        return
    end

    local report = AudioConfig:Validate(folder)
    if #report.Missing > 0 or #report.Extras > 0 then
        local message = string.format(
            "registry mismatch: missing=%s extras=%s",
            table.concat(report.Missing, ","),
            table.concat(report.Extras, ",")
        )
        if RunService:IsStudio() then
            error("[AudioConfig] " .. message)
        else
            warn("[AudioConfig] " .. message)
        end
    end
end

task.defer(validateRegistry)

local function getRootPart(character)
    if not character then return nil end
    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character.PrimaryPart
        or character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end

local function resolveEmitter(emitter)
    if typeof(emitter) ~= "Instance" then
        return nil
    end
    if emitter:IsA("Model") then
        return getRootPart(emitter)
    end
    if emitter:IsA("BasePart") or emitter:IsA("Attachment") then
        return emitter
    end
    if emitter:IsA("Sound") then
        return emitter.Parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function resolvePosition(emitter, fallbackPosition)
    if typeof(fallbackPosition) == "Vector3" then
        return fallbackPosition
    end

    local resolved = resolveEmitter(emitter)
    if not resolved then return nil end
    if resolved:IsA("BasePart") then
        return resolved.Position
    end
    if resolved:IsA("Attachment") then
        return resolved.WorldPosition
    end
    return nil
end

local function getPlayerRoot(player)
    return player and getRootPart(player.Character)
end

local playerRoots = {}
local rootConnections = {}

local function bindPlayerRoot(player)
    local function setRoot(character)
        local root = getRootPart(character) or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if player.Character == character then
            playerRoots[player] = root
        end
    end

    if player.Character then
        setRoot(player.Character)
    end

    rootConnections[player] = {
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setRoot),
        player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
            if playerRoots[player] == getRootPart(character) then
                playerRoots[player] = nil
            end
        end),
    }
end

local function unbindPlayerRoot(player)
    playerRoots[player] = nil
    local connections = rootConnections[player]
    if connections then
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    rootConnections[player] = nil
end

if not isClient then
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        bindPlayerRoot(player)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(bindPlayerRoot)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unbindPlayerRoot)
end

local function getGroup(category)
    local effectFolder = getEffectFolder()
    if category == "UI" then
        return SoundService:FindFirstChild("UISound")
    end
    if category == "ControlledLoop" then
        category = "World"
    end
    return effectFolder and effectFolder:FindFirstChild("SFX_" .. category)
end

function AudioHelper:GetEffectSound(name)
    local effectFolder = getEffectFolder()
    return effectFolder and effectFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
end

local function tweenVolume(sound, isPlay)
    if not sound then return end

    local originVolume = sound:GetAttribute("OriginVolume")
    if originVolume == nil then
        originVolume = sound.Volume
        sound:SetAttribute("OriginVolume", originVolume)
    end

    local volume = 0
    if isPlay then
        sound.Volume = 0
        volume = originVolume
        if not sound.Playing then
            sound:Play()
        end
    end

    local tween = TweenService:Create(sound, musicTweenInfo, {Volume = volume})
    if not isPlay then
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if sound.Playing then
                sound:Stop()
            end
        end)
    end
    tween:Play()
end

function AudioHelper:PlayMusic(name)
    if not name then return end
    local musicFolder = SoundService:FindFirstChild("MainMusic")
    local music = musicFolder and musicFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not music or not music:IsA("Sound") or currentBGM == music then return end

    if currentBGM then
        tweenVolume(currentBGM, false)
        currentBGM = nil
    end

    tweenVolume(music, true)
    currentBGM = music
end

function AudioHelper:StopMusic(name)
    if not name then return end
    local musicFolder = SoundService:FindFirstChild("MainMusic")
    local music = musicFolder and musicFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not music or not music:IsA("Sound") then return end

    tweenVolume(music, false)
    if currentBGM == music then
        currentBGM = nil
    end
end

local function dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
    if not player or player.Parent ~= Players then return end
    OnPlaySound:FireClient(player, name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options)
end

local function findEmitterPlayer(emitter)
    local resolved = resolveEmitter(emitter)
    local model = resolved and resolved:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    return model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
end

local function dispatchToNearby(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, options, config)
    local position = resolvePosition(emitter, fallbackPosition)
    local radius = config.Radius or 0
    local radiusSquared = radius * radius
    local targetUserId = options and options.TargetUserId
    local targetPlayer = targetUserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetUserId) or nil
    if not targetPlayer and (config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local") then
        targetPlayer = findEmitterPlayer(emitter)
    end

    if targetPlayer then
        dispatchToPlayer(targetPlayer, name, emitter, position, options)
    end

    if config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local" then
        return
    end

    if config.Scope == "Global" then
        OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(name, emitter, position, options)
        return
    end
    if not position then
        if not targetPlayer then
            warn("[AudioHelper] spatial sound has no position: " .. tostring(name))
            OnPlaySound:FireAllClients(name, emitter, position, options)
        end
        return
    end

    for player, root in pairs(playerRoots) do
        if player.Parent == Players and root and root.Parent and (not targetPlayer or player ~= targetPlayer) then
            local delta = root.Position - position
            if delta:Dot(delta) <= radiusSquared then
                dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, position, options)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function dispatch(name, emitter, options, command)
    local config = AudioConfig:Get(name)
    if not config then
        warn("[AudioHelper] refusing server broadcast for unregistered sound: " .. tostring(name))
        return
    end

    local fallbackPosition = options and options.FallbackPosition
    local payload = copyOptions(options)
    if not command and config.PlaybackMode == "Exclusive" then
        command = "StartExclusive"
        payload._ExclusiveKey = payload._ExclusiveKey or payload.ExclusiveKey or name
    elseif not command and config.PlaybackMode == "ControlledLoop" then
        command = "StartLoop"
        payload._ExclusiveKey = payload._ExclusiveKey or payload.ExclusiveKey or name
    end
    if command then
        payload._Command = command
    end

    if payload._TargetPlayer then
        payload._TargetPlayer = nil
    end

    if config.Scope == "Target" or config.Scope == "Local" then
        local player = payload.TargetUserId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(payload.TargetUserId) or findEmitterPlayer(emitter)
        if player then
            dispatchToPlayer(player, name, emitter, resolvePosition(emitter, fallbackPosition), payload)
        end
        return
    end

    dispatchToNearby(name, emitter, fallbackPosition, payload, config)
end

local function makeTempEmitter(position)
    if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end

    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "LocalAudioEmitter"
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.Size = Vector3.one
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    part.Parent = workspace
    return part
end

local function sourceToken(emitter, options)
    if options and options.SourceKey ~= nil then
        return tostring(options.SourceKey)
    end
    if options and options.SourceUserId then
        return "user:" .. tostring(options.SourceUserId)
    end
    if typeof(emitter) == "Instance" then
        return emitter
    end
    return "local"
end

local function sourceKey(name, source)
    return name .. "|" .. tostring(source)
end

local function localDistanceScore(position)
    local character = Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = getRootPart(character)
    if not root or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
        return 0
    end

    local delta = root.Position - position
    local distanceSquared = delta:Dot(delta)
    if distanceSquared <= 30 * 30 then return 300 end
    if distanceSquared <= 100 * 100 then return 200 end
    if distanceSquared <= 250 * 250 then return 100 end
    return 0
end

local function priorityFor(name, config, emitter, options)
    local priority = config.BasePriority or 0
    local position = resolvePosition(emitter, options and options.FallbackPosition)

    if config.Category == "Weapon" then
        if options and options.SourceUserId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
            priority += 1000
        end
        if options and options.TargetUserId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
            priority += 800
        end
    elseif config.Category == "Impact" and options and options.TargetUserId == Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
        priority += 1200
    end

    priority += (tonumber(options and options.Importance) or 0) * 100
    priority += localDistanceScore(position)
    return priority
end

local function removeFromList(list, record)
    for index = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[index] == record then
            table.remove(list, index)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function removeRecord(record, destroySound)
    if not record or record.removed then return end
    record.removed = true

    if record.connection then
        record.connection:Disconnect()
        record.connection = nil
    end
    if record.ancestryConnection then
        record.ancestryConnection:Disconnect()
        record.ancestryConnection = nil
    end

    oneShots[record.sound] = nil
    removeFromList(activeRecords, record)
    activeCount = math.max(0, activeCount - 1)

    local categoryList = byCategory[record.category]
    if categoryList then
        removeFromList(categoryList, record)
    end

    if destroySound and record.sound and record.sound.Parent then
        record.sound:Destroy()
    end
    if record.tempEmitter and record.tempEmitter.Parent then
        record.tempEmitter:Destroy()
    end
end

local function fadeReplace(record)
    if not record or record.removed then return end
    local sound = record.sound
    if not sound or not sound.Parent then
        removeRecord(record, true)
        return
    end

    local tween = TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(0.03, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0})
    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        if sound.Parent then sound:Stop() end
        removeRecord(record, true)
    end)
    tween:Play()
end

local function cleanupStale(category)
    local list = byCategory[category]
    if not list then return end
    for index = #list, 1, -1 do
        local record = list[index]
        if record.removed or not record.sound or not record.sound.Parent then
            removeRecord(record, true)
        end
    end
end

local function findEviction(config, newPriority, newSource)
    cleanupStale(config.Category)

    local sourceLimit = config.MaxPerSource or AudioConfig.Budgets.Total
    if sourceLimit > 0 then
        local sourceCount = 0
        local sourceCandidate
        for _, record in ipairs(activeRecords) do
            if not record.removed and record.category == config.Category and record.source == newSource then
                sourceCount += 1
                if not sourceCandidate or record.priority < sourceCandidate.priority or (record.priority == sourceCandidate.priority and record.startedAt < sourceCandidate.startedAt) then
                    sourceCandidate = record
                end
            end
        end
        if sourceCount >= sourceLimit then
            if sourceCandidate and newPriority >= sourceCandidate.priority then
                return sourceCandidate
            end
            return false
        end
    end

    if activeCount >= AudioConfig.Budgets.Total then
        local candidate
        for _, record in ipairs(activeRecords) do
            if not record.removed and (not candidate or record.priority < candidate.priority or (record.priority == candidate.priority and record.startedAt < candidate.startedAt)) then
                candidate = record
            end
        end
        if candidate and newPriority >= candidate.priority then
            return candidate
        end
        return false
    end

    local list = byCategory[config.Category] or {}
    local budget = AudioConfig.Budgets[config.Category] or AudioConfig.Budgets.Total
    if #list >= budget then
        local candidate
        for _, record in ipairs(list) do
            if not record.removed and (not candidate or record.priority < candidate.priority or (record.priority == candidate.priority and record.startedAt < candidate.startedAt)) then
                candidate = record
            end
        end
        if candidate and newPriority >= candidate.priority then
            return candidate
        end
        return false
    end
    return nil
end

local function beginLoad(sound, prefab)
    if sound.IsLoaded then return true end

    local soundId = prefab.SoundId
    if not loadingIds[soundId] and pendingLoads < 8 then
        loadingIds[soundId] = true
        pendingLoads += 1
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({prefab})
            end)
            loadingIds[soundId] = nil
            pendingLoads = math.max(0, pendingLoads - 1)
        end)
    end
    return false
end

local function playWhenReady(record, prefab, config)
    local sound = record.sound
    if not sound or not sound.Parent or record.removed then return end

    local played = false
    local loadedConnection
    local timeoutToken = {}

    local function start()
        if played or record.removed or not sound.Parent then return end
        played = true
        if loadedConnection then
            loadedConnection:Disconnect()
            loadedConnection = nil
        end
        sound:Play()
    end

    if beginLoad(sound, prefab) then
        start()
    else
        loadedConnection = sound.Loaded:Connect(start)
        task.delay(math.max(0.05, config.MaxStartDelay or 0), function()
            if not played then
                if sound.IsLoaded then
                    start()
                else
                    removeRecord(record, true)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    record.connection = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
        removeRecord(record, true)
    end)
    record.ancestryConnection = sound.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            removeRecord(record, false)
        end
    end)
end
